confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Guangzhou price levels, not checked against live menus or booking listings. Restaurant and café anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is sensitive to July summer-holiday demand. midrange_meal_2p is the least certain, since 'three-course' is ambiguous for Chinese restaurants. The FX observation came from search-result text on the RBA overview page and was not verified against the F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other large mainland Chinese metropolitan cities (Shenzhen, Shanghai-lite price tiers for food and transport) and adjusted for Guangzhou's generally lower hotel and restaurant costs. Beer and cocktail/wine were set relative to the local beer price, since direct bar-price knowledge is weaker.
